posts.title: Gay Bar: Material
posts.description: I entered a gay bar full of bears with two trans friends. The barman welcomed us. I spent the rest of the evening trying to understand how bodies move. The three of us clicked quickly. We started talking about hormones: testosterone, estrogen, menopause for transmasculine people. And the idea of going to a gay sauna together came up. posts.title: Agent: Norm
posts.description: A programmer friend told me she hasn’t coded for a year. She gives the work to AI agents. She also lost a contract to someone who could vibe code: give instructions to an AI, receive the code. I’m trying to understand what these agents are. There is the word: AGENT. posts.title: Questions: Genealogy
posts.description: These are the questions I keep asking. I don't know which one is the question yet, maybe the relation between them is. What if using an AI agent makes me submit in a way I cannot describe? What if the words I would use to describe it are also being shaped through that interaction?
